PCI.BIO: Cheng provides a great learning experience through a well-balanced mix of classroom courses and labs. He is passionate about providing an exceptional student experience to the students he teaches. In the continuation of personal and social-professional development, he provides instructional resources and materials to support effective learning in line with university curriculum requirements. Cheng is also active in research, development, and teaching in the areas of digital systems engineering, computer network security, and computer architecture.

SERVICE_DEPARTMENT.ORG: NSF-PRIMERS Learning by Design professional development program
SERVICE_DEPARTMENT.DESC: The primary goal of PRIMERS project is to move undergraduate STEM instructors away from traditional teacher-centered lecture-based instruction, toward learning-centered active learning-based instruction. The secondary goal is to create, test, and implement different versions of the Learning by Design program in ways that are sensitive to differences between institutions and their varied missions and contexts.
